title: Datasets public >30 days after their paper rose from 32% to 56% after 2020, all on bulk days
sub:
Public release minus publication date of the linked paper (OpenAlex): 27,001 of 36,209 datasets have a dated paper. Bulk day: a calendar day with ≥50 PRIDE
releases (62 days, all since Oct 2018). Release years 2013–20 vs 2021–25: >30 d after on other days 26% vs 22%; on bulk days 7% vs 34%.
Intervals: 95% over 2,000 resamples of contributor groups. Descriptive only: who set a release date is not recorded.
